en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a traditional entrance with elaborate tilework and a small arched door, under a wooden awning with intricate carvings. Two individuals in traditional North African garb sit at the entrance. The structure has an ornate lantern hanging from the awning. There is French text at the bottom identifying the location as 'Sidi-Bou-Medine - Entrée de la Koubba.'
